entries.title: Serial mosaic matrix exceeds job deadline
entries.root_cause: The mosaic matrix suite runs all 480 expensive rendering cases serially and cannot finish within the 20-minute job timeout. Shard the suite or allocate sufficient job time.

entries.title: Native contour extension lacks development headers
entries.root_cause: The contour native extension cannot compile because the runner lacks the libyaml development headers. Install the development package before bundle install.

entries.title: Mosaic export endpoint is unset
entries.root_cause: The export configuration fetches MOSAIC_QUAY_EXPORT_URL, which is absent from the job environment. Configure that variable for the job.

entries.title: Serial mosaic matrix hits job deadline again
entries.root_cause: The mosaic matrix suite runs all 480 expensive rendering cases serially and cannot finish within the 20-minute job timeout. Shard the suite or allocate sufficient job time.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run on a different runner reaches another case in the same serial matrix after different setup and output before the job deadline.
